new_learnings.text: Post-panic recovery days create tension: sectors are hot (+11%) but individual stocks remain below MAs (-12% to -25%). V2 momentum framework says wait for individual strength confirmation rather than buying the turn. This discipline prevented chasing 昭衍新药 (dist_ma20 +19.5%, Rule 2b violation).
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector strength can mask individual stock weakness during V-bottoms. MA-distance discipline ensures entries happen when stocks confirm recovery, not when they're merely bouncing.

new_learnings.text: Breadth quality vs quantity: 1.35:1 ratio understates today's tape quality. r7_10 + r10 = 590 stocks surging 7%+ vs only 29 limit-downs. A modified breadth gate weighting magnitude (e.g., (r7_10+r10)/(f7_10+f10) > 5) could better identify high-conviction recovery days vs weak breadth days.
new_learnings.mechanism: Standard up/down ratio treats +0.01% and +10% equally. On strong sector rotation days, concentration of big movers in tech can produce high-quality breadth that a simple ratio misses.

new_learnings.text: IV at 1.00 rank (panic extremes) across all ETFs historically signals medium-term buying opportunity, but short-term volatility makes -5% hard stops vulnerable. Consider: when IV rank > 0.90, widen stops to -7% and reduce position size by 25% to accommodate gap risk, especially in 科创板 names.
new_learnings.mechanism: Extreme IV implies daily swings of 5-10% are normal. A -5% stop in a 10% daily range environment triggers on noise, not thesis failure. Wider stops with smaller sizing preserve the trade thesis while managing total risk.

new_learnings.text: The 2-week tech selloff was driven by technical factors (长鑫存储 295亿 IPO liquidity drain, forced margin deleveraging) not fundamental deterioration. Star宸科技 H1 +583-650% and 扬杰科技 H1 +20-40% confirm AI/semiconductor demand remains strong. This pattern — technical flush in a structural bull trend — historically produces the best risk/reward entries.
new_learnings.mechanism: IPO liquidity events and margin cascades are transient. When they hit structurally growing sectors, the subsequent recovery is typically sharp (today +10.73% on 科创50 confirms).

new_learnings.text: Margin signal corroboration: 中石科技 margin chg5 +126% (adding) vs 思瑞浦/路维光电/扬杰科技 all showing deleveraging (-9% to -12%). In a recovery, stocks with margin adding are showing smart-money conviction. This should be weighted more heavily when comparing otherwise similar candidates.
new_learnings.mechanism: Margin adding during a selloff indicates leveraged sophisticated investors see the dip as an opportunity, not a reason to exit. Deleveraging during the same period indicates forced selling or loss of conviction.
